provenance.question: Which category does this image belong to?

hyperparams.optimizer: HeadTrainer AdamW (lr a priori, no search)

cell_definitions.V0: reference: the shipped stack (interaction ON, state_pathway=mlp)
cell_definitions.V0L: supplementary: the shipped stack with the CURRENT config default state_pathway='linear' (the MODALITY_BENCHMARKS.md 4.1 stack)
cell_definitions.V1: conditioning_mode=off equivalent: state-only head, schema removed before fusion, residual exactly zero (the shipped forward(condition_options=False) path)
cell_definitions.V2: state path ONLY as an exact nn.Linear(D,K) probe (P1): state_proj -> Linear(192,10), no question/schema/fusion
cell_definitions.V3: V2 + probe-style initialization of the state path (nn.Linear's own kaiming-uniform weight / uniform bias instead of the shipped zero-init residual convention)
cell_definitions.V2m: V2 with the mlp state path, H = D = 192 (sweep centre for V5)
cell_definitions.V6: V2 with a class-balanced (inverse-frequency) re-weighting of the training cross-entropy
cell_definitions.V2I: V2 expressed ONLY through shipped config fields: fusion_type='identity' (the Fusion.context of jevx/representations/fusion.py:IdentityFusion returns the state unchanged) + conditioning_mode='off' + state_pathway='linear'. Confirms the V2 logits are reachable without any code change.
cell_definitions.R1: B1 linear probe, nn.Linear(192,10) on the pooled feature (== P1), same features / splits / 5 seeds
cell_definitions.R2: B2 MLP probe, Linear(192,192)-ReLU-Linear(192,10) (== P2), same features / splits / 5 seeds

wrapper_equivalence.check: VisionHead(conditioning=True, use_question=True) vs benchmarks.bench_common.FeaturizedJevX on 8 cached rows, canonical model (shipped default fusion_type='concat', state_pathway='mlp')
